evals.prompt: Research how task apps handle priorities before we spec the feature — write a research brief.
evals.expected_output: A research-brief.md (frontmatter type/feature/status/date/sources[]) that fans out research tracks, synthesizes findings with cited sources, and ends with conclusions + recommendations.
assertions: A research-brief.md handoff is produced with frontmatter listing sources
Findings are synthesized across tracks (not a single undifferentiated dump)
Claims are backed by cited sources
The brief ends with conclusions and recommendations for the next phase

evals.prompt: Investigate the options and prior art for adding full-text search; compare approaches and recommend one.
evals.expected_output: A research brief comparing the main options with evidence, ending in a recommendation.
assertions: Each option is supported by evidence/sources
A recommendation is made with rationale

evals.prompt: Explore the landscape for our notifications idea across product and engineering angles.
evals.expected_output: A brief covering more than one research direction (e.g. product + engineering), synthesized.
assertions: More than one research direction is covered (e.g. product and engineering)
The directions are synthesized into one coherent brief
The output is a research brief, not a PRD or a design

component.purpose: Phase workflow: investigate a feature before it is specified — fan out parallel research tracks (delegating codebase exploration to Explore and external research to deep-research), synthesize, and produce a research-brief.md with cited sources and recommendations, gated by a bounded skeptic loop (reviewer + the external-reviewer lens, --kind research; exit via review_loop_decision, ADR 0061). Gated at Tier-1 (routing); depth quality comes from the delegated deep-research skill + the brief schema + that loop.

should_trigger: Research how other task apps handle priorities before we spec it
Investigate the options and prior art for adding full-text search
Explore the landscape for our notifications idea and write a research brief
Compare approaches for X and recommend one before we design it
What are the options for X? Research and produce a brief.
should_not_trigger: Write a PRD with goals and acceptance criteria for the feature
Design the technical architecture for the feature
Implement the feature in a worktree
Break the design into a dependency-ordered task plan
Review my diff for bugs and security
